name: Fullscreen Image Menu
description: Full-screen hero with a looping video or image background and a round toggle button that opens a right-aligned link list. Hovering a link crossfades the background to that link's image.
contents: Logo text block at top left
Looping background video with poster, or a hero image
Round hamburger toggle button at top right
Numbered link list with subtitle and serif italic label
One full-bleed background image per link
behavior: Toggle button morphs into a cross and slides the link list in
Hero dims when open and dims further while a link is hovered or focused
Hovered or focused link crossfades in its own background image with a slight zoom
Link rows shift left and show an underline on hover
editableByProps: Logo text, link count, labels, subtitles, numbers, hrefs and per-link images
Hero video or image; an empty videoSrc shows the image instead

needsCodeEdit.change: Change colors, blur and dimming levels

needsCodeEdit.where: serif and sans font definitions at the top

fixed: Uses next/font/google for Cormorant Garamond and Inter, so it needs Next.js
Fills the viewport height as a full-bleed section
